item.title: Hi i just downloaded and finished both butterfly soup games in the span of 24 hours. Why on earth…

item.category: diyamin and ppkm are great and all but
i Love the idea that noelle had a small crush on diya when they were kids but repressed it super hard
because her parents taught her to think girls liking girls was wrong
i also quite like minkarsha too except i have no explanation as to why this time
they bring out the worst in each other but in a funny way
also i saw a tumblr post saying that noelle's crush on akarsha in the second game was written really rushed and i kinda agree
i didn't dislike that part but i feel like they went too hard on cramming everything in
especially with noelle having the last section
my thoughts are pretty much the same as this person's
i still like ppkm but i prefer it when it's one sided on akarsha's side kind of if that makes sense
